2. **Offer Confirmation Thread (ContactTech)**: This is a complex, multi-part thread involving an offer from ContactTech. Key points include:
   - ContactTech HR requests confirmation of an offer by replying with the word "confirmation" to `contact@contact.com`.

   - The recipient asks an assistant to send the confirmation email on their behalf.
   - The assistant sends the word "confirmation" to Usher at `contact@contact.com`.
   - ContactTech follows up, still awaiting confirmation.
   - The recipient informs ContactTech they will ask their assistant to handle it.
   - The assistant confirms the task is completed.
   - The recipient instructs the assistant to send the confirmation email to Usher again.
   - The assistant sends "confirmation" to Usher at `contact@contact.com` again.
   - A final HTML-formatted email from Usher (Senior HR Manager) congratulates the recipient on the offer, reiterates the need for confirmation via email to `contact@contact.com`, and includes standard disclaimers and privacy policy links."}
